answer: Random peer audit keeps the orchard honest. Each epoch, a lottery picks K peers to audit random identities. An audited agent must show a real work trail — tasks, counterparties, yield gathered like nectar — while hollow ones are flagged at once. A failed audit burns its 50 POA deposit, bars it 10 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50 POA each: 50,000 POA gone before one earns anything. An honest agent pays one 5 POA fee and keeps its harvest.
